en: ...Hikari, aren't you going to play{SAUT}superhero today?{PAGE}That's the only thing you've wanted to{SAUT}do until lately―you love superheroes...
No... I think I'm done. I got bored{SAUT}playing superhero.
I see... Are you sure you won't be{SAUT}bored today?
I'll be fine. Even if I'm by myself... I'll just{SAUT}watch movies.
Ah! I see...{PAGE}Then, why don't we go see a movie{SAUT}together next Sunday?
Really!? What about your work, though?
Oh, I'll work hard and make sure{SAUT}to finish everything beforehand.
But, then won't you be too tired?
Even if I come home tired, it'll be fine―{SAUT}seeing you will perk me right up.{PAGE}You're my hero, Hikari.
*giggle* Yay!{PAGE}And... um... I made up my mind!

When I grow up, I'm gonna make{SAUT}movies!{PAGE}You love movies, right Dad? I love them{SAUT}too...{PAGE}That's why I'm gonna make tons of them{SAUT}for you to watch.{PAGE}When I finish one, come see it, okay?{SAUT}Promise me?
Well, that's something I really look{SAUT}forward to.{PAGE}I wonder what kind of movie you'll{SAUT}make... I can't wait to see it.
